facts.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
facts.doc_title: OEM Advisory - Mechanical Seal Support System Barrier Fluid Degradation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.body: The emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment shall be provided and maintained for work covered by this safety alert. This clause applies to activities archived under CONTAINMENT-OF-HYDROCARBONS at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
